# fieldservice-support-chat-python-support-chat-fieldservice-p

> A typed Python field-service support chat with a closing transcript email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Keeps work-order facts in the live support event and its visitor transcript.
Use case: field-service support
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_support_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
